niche_preference_profile: Prefers calm, spacious, polished interfaces with strong hierarchy, soft rounded surfaces, and restrained editorial styling. They consistently like light or muted neutral presentations, generous breathing room, clear section grouping, and content that feels trustworthy, structured, and easy to scan. They also often prefer subtle or secondary imagery over dominant photo banners, and favor controls that make choices explicit without adding clutter.

criteria.description: Prefers open layouts with generous whitespace, fewer competing elements, slower visual rhythm, and reduced decorative or structural clutter.
Prefers bold, obvious top-down hierarchy with prominent headlines, clearly chunked sections, and a single readable content flow.
Prefers gentle rounded cards and subtly separated surfaces that blend smoothly rather than sharp, rigid, high-contrast containers.
Prefers soft, airy, understated, modern editorial aesthetics over heavy, promotional, flashy, or aggressively branded presentation.
Prefers settings and permissions that are clearly grouped and expressed through informative controls such as segmented selectors, labeled sections, and self-contained option groups.
Prefers imagery that is subtle, integrated, and secondary to content rather than large dark banners or hero photos that overpower the interface.
